goal.text: v7 makes evidence useful, risk-scaled, and portable
goal.reason: the release of the format version 6 makes the aim name the version it holds

claims.text: pure verdict laws and freshness

review.reason: the contract now names risk and observed states

claims.falsifier: a broken verdict or freshness rule passes

claims.text: strict versioned JSON codecs
claims.falsifier: an unknown, duplicate, or legacy-invalid field is accepted

claims.text: the CLI produces fresh independent evidence
claims.falsifier: a claim holds without current independent evidence

claims.text: ADR and JUnit are imported read-only with provenance
claims.falsifier: an import writes the source or loses nested evidence

claims.text: MCP returns typed JSON-RPC results and actionable errors
claims.falsifier: a result is prose instead of structured JSON or an invalid protocol is accepted

claims.text: protected transitions and the measurement stand work on installed tools
claims.falsifier: an unauthorized transition passes or the stand cannot find mathc
claims.control: sed -i 's/match Sys.getenv_opt "MATHC" with/match Some "\/definitely-missing-mathc" with/' bin/stand.ml

claims.text: installed mathc and stand work together
claims.falsifier: an installed tool cannot run or stand cannot find mathc

claims.text: portable mathc and stand run outside the Nix store
claims.falsifier: a portable binary needs Nix store paths or cannot run
claims.control: sed -i 's/dune build --root . bin\/mathc.exe bin\/stand.exe/dune build --root . missing-target/' flake.nix

claims.text: the repository keeps the shape the method needs: every module has its interface, the format layer loses no error silently, the legacy implementation is absent and the practices are written
claims.falsifier: a module loses its interface, the format layer loses an error silently, the legacy implementation returns or the practices document disappears

claims.text: the size of the code stays within the bounds of the practices: the core, the format layer and the split CLI
claims.falsifier: the core, the format layer or a module of them outgrows its bound
claims.control:
printf 'val x : int
' > lib/long_module.mli && printf 'let x = 0
' > lib/long_module.ml && for i in $(seq 1 300); do printf 'let v%d = %d
' $i $i >> lib/long_module.ml; done

claims.text: local binaries, agent skill, and canonical methodology install cleanly
claims.falsifier: the installer succeeds but a binary, skill, or canonical methodology is missing or unusable

claims.text: an installed agent can integrate no-ADR and MADR projects

requirements.spec: nix build .#default .#stand --no-link && MATHC="$(nix path-info .#default)/bin/mathc" MATHC_STAND="$(nix path-info .#stand)/bin/stand" sh test/agent_onboarding.sh

claims.falsifier: the onboarding path passes without exercising the actual workflow

claims.text: the delivery workflow is valid
claims.falsifier: an invalid workflow passes validation

claims.text: the published pages show the map of the tool - the verdict, the states, the coverage, the build that computed them and the legend of the reasons - and every published page names itself, both languages and the preview
claims.falsifier: a claim is missing from the rendered map, a page shows a state that mathc map does not report, or a published page lacks its address, its alternates or its preview

claims.text: on a phone screen the navigation keeps every item and every frame in both themes, the text and the state pills keep their measured contrast, and the English and the Russian pages are drawn by the same typefaces
claims.falsifier: a navigation item or a button is cut off on a phone screen, the text or a pill in one of the themes falls below the measured contrast, or the English and the Russian pages are drawn by different typefaces

claims.text: the apparatus of the field measurement is whole and runnable: the ledger accepts consistent records and rejects inconsistent comparisons, and the protocol declares what the measurement needs

requirements.spec: test -f docs/measurements/BENCHMARK-PROTOCOL.md && test -s docs/measurements/dry-run.jsonl && test -f docs/measurements/task-ledger.py && for part in "Экспериментальные руки" "Baseline" "Checklist" "Protocol" "Набор задач" "число задач и повторов" "критерий принятого результата" "Критерий принятия метода" "не менее 30% снижения" "независимый оценщик" "независимым ревьюером" "отличная по числу задач"; do grep -qF "$part" docs/measurements/BENCHMARK-PROTOCOL.md || exit 1; done

claims.falsifier: an inconsistent task record is accepted, a valid dry run is rejected, the protocol stops declaring what the measurement needs or a part of the apparatus is missing
claims.control: sed -i 's/^## 2\. Экспериментальные руки/## 2. Руки сравнения/' docs/measurements/BENCHMARK-PROTOCOL.md

claims.text: the Math Coding console shows the canonical map only, keeps the host boundary explicit and refuses to invent a reason
claims.falsifier: the console computes a verdict or a claim state on its own, or the shared interface imports the host package directly

claims.text: the development shell keeps stdout free of prose, so the machine interface stays machine readable
claims.falsifier: the notice of the development shell reaches stdout, or the map stops being the only thing on stdout

claims.text: the runner notices a finished child at once and never adds a delay of its own
claims.falsifier: a child that ends at once is noticed late, or a child that runs long is not waited for
claims.control: sed -i 's/let pause = ref 0.002/let pause = ref 0.05/' adapter/process.ml

claims.text: the console opens with the queue of the human: the expectations, the checks, the evidence and the state come from the canonical map, and the queue never computes a state of its own
claims.falsifier: the queue shows a state that the canonical map does not state, or it hides a condition of a declared claim

claims.text: the console shows the files of the subject inside the repository and reads no file outside it
claims.falsifier: the panel reads a file outside the workspace, or it follows a symbolic link out of the repository

claims.text: the development shell is ready for work: its tools come from the store, the node of the shell is taken from the binary cache, and the shell stays in the store
claims.falsifier: the node of the development shell is compiled from the sources, or the collector of garbage takes the shell away

claims.text: the local browser page is one interface: the bundle holds one copy of the shared interface and one copy of the data layer, and the page renders the queue of the human
claims.falsifier: the page carries a second copy of the interface or of the data layer, or the page does not render the queue of the human

claims.text: the console shows the manual steps of the method and performs them through the program itself: the human decides, the program records
claims.falsifier: the console performs a step the canonical map does not offer, or it performs a decision without the explicit confirmation of the human

claims.text: the console opens the sheet of the host with the surface of the host inside it: the claim detail of the queue, the confirmation of a run, the decision of the method and the preview of a file stay readable in the host
claims.falsifier: the sheet of the host draws a view that the host cannot draw, or the surface of the host is missing inside the sheet

claims.text: the report of the bilingual console is in step with the work it describes: it keeps the sections it promises, names the catalogue of every language the console ships, and states the number of claims the project has
claims.falsifier: the report states a number of claims, a language or a section the project does not have

claims.text: the console names the permission that is closed and opens the settings of the host, so a closed button is never a button without a reason
claims.falsifier: the console leaves a closed action unexplained, or offers no way to the settings that open it

claims.text: the canonical documents of the method are intact: their numbered lists run from one to the last without a gap and without a repeat, and every document the canon names is there
claims.falsifier: a canonical document is renumbered wrongly, loses a required document or is missing

claims.text: the frozen corpus gives the same map on every build
claims.falsifier: a build moves the verdict or the state of a frozen project, and the corpus does not notice

claims.text: a project of the previous version of the format is moved to this version, and no record of the journal is lost or invented
claims.falsifier: a project of the previous version cannot be moved, or the move loses a record or claims a record it did not read
claims.control: sed -i "s/let evidence = Migration.rebind_definitions spec journals.evidence in/let evidence = [] in/" bin/migrate.ml

claims.text: the console reads the project in the schema of its own generation, names the generation it read, and fills nothing that the generation did not write
claims.falsifier: the console refuses a project of a generation it knows, or it names what that generation did not name

claims.text: the method measurably helps development
claims.falsifier: the preregistered field pilot does not meet the acceptance criteria

claims.text: the library of negative controls mutates common subjects
claims.falsifier: a control leaves the subject unchanged
